How to Open a UK Business Bank Account for a Non-Resident Company

A comprehensive guide for foreign directors on securing UK Sort Codes, GBP/USD/EUR multi-currency accounts, and digital banking approval remotely from abroad.

ADVAQ Legal Team
8 Min Read · Published July 2026
FCA & HMRC Compliant Banking
Executive Banking Summary (TL;DR)
  • •No UK Travel Required: Non-residents can open business bank accounts 100% online through FCA-regulated digital banking platforms.
  • •Top 3 Digital Banks: Wise Business, Payoneer, and Revolut Business offer the highest approval rates for foreign-owned UK LTDs.
  • •Official UK Account Details: You receive an official UK Sort Code, 8-digit Account Number, and IBAN in your company's name.
  • •Fast Approval: Digital verification completes within 24 to 48 hours after submitting Incorporation Certificates and Passport ID.

1. The Banking Challenge for Non-Resident Directors

Once your UK Limited Company is registered with Companies House, the immediate next step is opening a corporate business bank account to receive client payments, pay software expenses, and manage payroll.

However, traditional UK high-street banks (Barclays, HSBC, Lloyds, NatWest) enforce strict internal compliance policies requiring company directors to be physical UK residents with a UK credit history and in-person branch verification.

Fortunately, the rise of FCA-regulated UK FinTech institutions has revolutionized cross-border banking. Foreign directors operating from Pakistan, the UAE, the US, or elsewhere can legally open dedicated UK business accounts remotely in 24–48 hours.

2. Top 3 Digital Business Banking Platforms Compared

Below is an in-depth comparison of the primary digital business banking providers supporting non-resident UK LTDs:

Wise Business (Formerly TransferWise)

MOST POPULAR

Wise Business is the gold standard for non-resident UK companies. It provides dedicated UK Sort Codes and Account Numbers, US Routing & Account Numbers, and European IBANs in over 40 currencies at mid-market exchange rates.

✓ UK Account Details: Sort Code & 8-digit Account Number
✓ Multi-Currency: Hold GBP, USD, EUR, CAD, AUD
✓ Integration: Connects to Xero, QuickBooks, Stripe
✓ Setup Fee: One-time £45 account verification fee

Payoneer for UK LTDs

BEST FOR E-COMMERCE & FREELANCERS

Payoneer provides receiving accounts in UK GBP, US USD, and EU EUR. It seamlessly integrates with Amazon UK, Upwork, Fiverr, eBay, and global B2B clients.

✓ Marketplace Ready: Direct Payouts from Upwork/Amazon
✓ Debit Card: Physical & Virtual Mastercard available
✓ Global Transfer: Withdraw to local overseas bank accounts
✓ Setup Fee: Free to apply for UK LTD owners

Revolut Business

BEST FOR EUROPEAN & UK DEALS

Revolut Business offers rapid digital onboarding, smart corporate employee cards, automated expense management, and multi-currency IBANs.

✓ Virtual Cards: Issue instant corporate debit cards
✓ API Access: Automated payment workflows
✓ Fast FX: Low-cost currency exchange
✓ Setup Fee: Free tier available

3. Documents Required for Banking Verification

To pass digital banking KYC (Know Your Customer) compliance, prepare the following official documents:

Mandatory Verification Checklist:

  • Certificate of Incorporation: Official PDF issued by Companies House displaying your Company Registration Number (CRN).
  • Memorandum & Articles of Association: Corporate governing documents.
  • Valid Director Passport: Clear color scan of passport photo page.
  • Director Proof of Address: Personal bank statement or utility bill (under 90 days old) matching passport name.
  • Business Web Presence: Active website URL, LinkedIn profile, or client invoice template describing your business services.

4. Step-by-Step Bank Account Opening Process

1

Submit Online Application

Create a business profile on Wise or Payoneer using your official UK LTD company name, CRN, and London registered office address.

2

Upload Identity & Company Certificates

Upload your passport scan, proof of address, Certificate of Incorporation, and PSC details.

3

Liveness Selfie Verification

Complete a 30-second biometric facial scan using your smartphone camera to confirm identity matching.

4

Receive UK Sort Code & Account Details

Within 24 to 48 hours, your UK account is activated, providing instant access to GBP Sort Codes and international payment links.

5. Common Rejection Causes & How to Avoid Them

Mismatched Names or Addresses: Ensure the address on your utility bill or bank statement matches the residential address entered in your application character for character.
Expired Documents: Submitting a proof of address older than 90 days causes immediate rejection.
